name: Froud
source:
One of the four devils out to devour Konoe. His demeanor is misleadingly sweet and playful, all the while unnerving and distant. Despite his age, he is unsurprisingly the least mature of the devils. He can manipulate wind.

[From [url=http://lamento.wikia.com/wiki/Froud]Lamento Wiki[/url]]
